grades.answer_evidence: At 2 conservation points, choose an Action-card upgrade or activate an additional association worker. At 5 and 8, choose 5 money or an available Bonus token. The first time anyone reaches 10, all players discard one Final Scoring card; if nobody reaches 10 before game end, everyone discards one before scoring. Check the game end at the end of your own turn or during a break when Appeal and Conservation are in the same scoring area or pass one another. Appeal gained during another player's turn waits until your own turn ends or a break, unless another player triggers the end first. If triggered at the end of a turn, the triggering player finishes and each other player gets one more turn; if triggered during a break, everyone gets one more turn. A Final Scoring card can award at most 4 conservation. Victory Points equal Appeal minus the lowest Appeal value in the scoring area containing your Conservation counter. Highest positive total wins; ties go to the player with the most supported conservation projects, then tied players share the win.
